## Triage: graded p1 · `domain:services` · `area:identity` · `security` · `pm:queue`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-21T09:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

- **The deferral question is answered:** the request quoted on this card, 「单独开一个 issue，把全家升到 1.7.12」, is the maintainer's own word. It is dated after #21094's deferral (2026-10-01), so it supersedes that deferral. No decision-box visit is needed.
- **Why p1:** the release carries security fixes in packages plugin-auth mounts, including the conditional critical GHSA-965c-763c-88jm (1.7.7).
- **Lane:** `plugin-auth` is `domain:services`'s (pm-dispatch lane table). One PR lifts the whole family, as the card asks.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json`: the five better-auth family ranges only;

- a test outside `plugin-auth` only where it pins a status the lift moves, each one named in the report;
- a new `.changeset/25096-*.md`.

⛔ No other dependency moves. ⛔ No 1.8.0 beta. ⛔ `packages/spec/**`, ⛔ `packages/objectql/**`. ⛔ No new override shape: the selector rule in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s header stands. (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus), quoting the --tier output "no path-derived mandate … floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable"`
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Responsibility: `the better-auth family is pinned at 1.7.3, below published security fixes in packages plugin-auth mounts | the maintainer's word on this card asks the whole family lifted to 1.7.12 | every deployment of plugin-auth`
Thread-read: 6313201609
Serial constraints cleared: `Serial dispatch: this is the seat's one card in flight (PR #25090 landed as 3782b2df6e). No open PR touches pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml or plugin-auth/package.json; PR #25099 adds one new plugin-auth test file, disjoint; the Version Packages PR #24876 regenerates itself. No in-flight claim in any lane declares these files.`

**Why `no (narrowing)`:** the lift brings refusals that 1.7.3 did not make. An OIDC SSO provider whose issuer does not exactly match its discovery document, and an ID token without `exp` or `iat`, are refused. A PKCE verifier mismatch moves from 401 to 400. In-flight Magic Link, OAuth, SAML and account-linking flows fail across the upgrade. So this ships as a BREAKING minor of `@objectstack/plugin-auth` under the amended 「甲」 (`6303865025`), not the card's `patch`, with a `!` title, its ADR-0087 disposition and the full dogfood battery on the final head. If the dev measures any change that WIDENS what is accepted, it names it in its report, and the seat rules the arm before landing.

Seat rulings on PR #25109's open questions · `domain:services` seat 1 · `session_011TdZ8GjixNZFLz1xJD9zzK` · 2026-10-21T11:53Z

- **Question 1** (the two out-of-surface stamps): **A**. The lift is what falsifies both lines, and both claims were re-measured true on 1.7.12. The spec docblock gains the re-measurement clause. The cli description drops the version, so no later lift can falsify that sentence again. The file surface is amended (claim amendment below this ruling), and both lanes have a declaration. If Check Changeset or the repo's changeset rules need `@objectstack/spec` or `@objectstack/cli` named, they ride as `patch` (prose only). Neither is BREAKING.
- **Question 2** (the DPoP `htu` binding): **A**. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` stands. The proof is now bound to this server's own configured public URL, which is RFC 9449's reading. That is the mirror of the narrowing on the same request, not a new acceptance class, and it comes with the family lift the maintainer asked for by name. The changeset already names both halves, and it keeps naming them.
- **Question 3** (an explicit token-storage option after GHSA-965c-763c-88jm): **A**. The vendor default stays. 1.7.12 closes the advisory on its own (measured), Magic Link is opt-in and no measured deployment enables it, and B or C would add surface that nothing pulls. If a real deployment turns Magic Link on, B, hard-coded with no knob, is the follow-up.
- **Out-of-scope findings:** the seat files the domain-verification and Magic Link lifetime readings as cards for triage. The `secondaryStorage` note stays in the PR's Acceptance notes.
